itemdesc-guidetool: Plan before you build: place translucent, world-shared voxel guides. Left-click acts by mode (create / edit / delete), F opens modes & settings, Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Y undo and redo. Placing guides uses up chalk (flat guides 1, volumes 2); refill the kit with Chalking Powder. An empty kit can still edit and dispel — it just can't draw new guides.
heldhelp-layout-roundoverroute: Set Fillet Sides · Add Sweep Path · Left-click Last Point Again to Finish
itemdesc-chalkingpowder: Yellow marking chalk for the Chalking Kit. Hold it and right-click to refill a kit anywhere in your hotbar, or SHIFT+right-click a kit set down on the ground to refill it in place — tap for one scoop (+4 chalk), keep holding to pour until full. Mixed from any powder and a splash of yellow dye.
